en: A giant olive, taller than a Smoliv, sits in the gap. {player} gave it a push...
It rolled away down the course and into the goal!
Another giant olive, glossy and green. {player} gave it a push...
It bumped off the rail and trundled into the goal!
The last olive was the roundest of all. {player} gave it a good push...
It rolled straight into the goal. The olive roll is cleared!
Oh my, you rolled every one of them in! You must be a challenger from the academy. I'm Katy, Cortondo's gym leader.
My Bug types are small, but sweet things can sting. Let's see how your team takes the heat of my oven!
Well, I never! That was baked to perfection. You've earned this: the Bug Badge.
{player} received the Bug Badge from Katy!
Come by the bakery any time. And good luck with the rest of Victory Road!
A challenger? Oh, but you aren't enrolled at the academy yet. Come back once term has started, dear.
Come back any time. I'll save you a pastry.
